name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1643: Pindleskin finally wears Pindleskin. The v1642 note claimed no Pindleskin render exists in the repo and that claim was FALSE: art/reanimatedhorde-opt_graphic.png has been on disk since 2026-06-14 and the app own name-to-art map D2IO_ART has read Pindleskin -> art/reanimatedhorde-opt_graphic.png at bible.html line 14217 for weeks. One grep would have found it. The picture was OPENED before wiring: a gaunt undead skeletal warrior on white with bare bone limbs, a rectangular shield on the left arm and a long thin spear angled down, a Reanimated Horde, which is Pindleskin own monster class. BOSS_PORTRAIT now covers 12 of 13 bosses. The lesson: before concluding an asset does not exist, ask the app what it already believes. The one refusal that was right is kept: never borrow the Nihlathak portrait for pindle, because _runBossArt returns the BOSSES name and a robed elder would arrive labelled Pindleskin. pit stays on level art by decision because The Pit is an area farm with no boss in it. Second fix: EVERY art url now carries the build id. Art was built as art/file with no version query while the page itself loads as ?v=build, so a version bump busted the HTML and the JS and never the IMAGES. v269 broke about 230 art files in place and v1636 repaired them in place under the same filenames, so every cached browser copy kept serving the old picture. That is why an already-correct Diablo render kept being re-reported as a book. One shared helper _artV stamps the two _runBossArt seams (the boss portrait and the TZ level art) and a DOM restamp plus MutationObserver stamps every other img src as it mounts, which is the layer that actually makes a repaired asset visible. The earlier claim that _artV also stamps _tzArtSrc, artUrl and _magicArtSrc was FALSE and is corrected here: those three were measured returning bare urls. Extending the stamp to them is a separate change because specs call them directly and 10 spec files anchor on a png end-of-string.
